concerns.text: Phase 5 (Fidelity scoring) does not explicitly state that the produced fidelity records are validated against the `fidelitymetric.schema.yaml` contract defined in `contracts/`. Adding this reference would close the plan↔contract linkage.

A contract file `fidelity.schema.yaml` exists but is not referenced by any plan step nor defined in `data-model.md`. This orphaned schema creates a cross‑document inconsistency; either remove the file or integrate it into the plan and data model.
